name: Doong's GD Utils
description: An in-game info HUD, instant restart, level info and crash-safe progress saving.

hud-enabled.name: Enable HUD
hud-enabled.description: Shows a compact info panel while playing a level.

hud-position.name: Position
hud-position.description: Which screen corner the HUD is anchored to.

hud-best.name: Show best percent
hud-best.description: Best normal-mode percent, or best practice percent while in practice mode.

hud-percent.name: Show live percent
hud-percent.description: Current progress with one decimal place.

instant-restart.name: Instant restart
instant-restart.description: Restarts the attempt immediately on death, skipping the death animation delay.

pause-info.name: Level info in pause menu
pause-info.description: Adds a level ID / object count / attempt readout and a Copy ID button to the pause menu.

save-on-background.name: Save when leaving the app
save-on-background.description: Forces a game save whenever the app goes to the background, so attempts and best percents survive if the system kills it.

resume-button.name: Resume button on the menu
resume-button.description: If the game closed while you were in an online level, shows a Resume button on the main menu that drops you straight back into that level, in practice mode if you were in it.
